set_value.name: global.$JKEOC_B70NextCycle
set_value.exact: player.age + 5min

set_value.name: $eligible
set_value.exact: ($evidence.$state == 'RECURRING' or $evidence.$state == 'SYSTEMIC') and ($evidence.$confidence == 'MEDIUM' or $evidence.$confidence == 'HIGH') and $evidence.$quality == 'COMPLETE'

set_value.name: $windowhits
set_value.exact: $windowhits + $hit

set_value.name: global.$JKEOC_B70NextIdentity
set_value.exact: global.$JKEOC_B70NextIdentity + 1

set_value.name: $remediation
set_value.exact: table[$identity=$identity, $station=$evidence.$station, $stationname=$evidence.$stationname, $category=$evidence.$category, $subject=$evidence.$subject, $subjectkey=$evidence.$subjectkey, $created=player.age, $updated=player.age, $state='OPEN', $priorstate='NONE', $evidence='', $diagnosis='', $recommendation='', $instruction='', $shipcapability='NONE', $assignment='NONE', $policy='NONE', $verification='MONITORING', $matchedship=null, $matchedidentity='', $lastamount=$evidence.$amount, $lasttarget=$evidence.$target, $lastwindowhits=$windowhits]

set_value.name: $created
set_value.exact: $created + 1

set_value.name: $remediation.$evidence
set_value.exact: '%1 of the last %2 bounded observations matched; total hits=%3 samples=%4; amount=%5 target=%6; suppliers=%7 suitable ships=%8 relevant activity=%9 idle/unknown=%10; confidence=%11.'.[$windowhits, $evidence.$window.count, $evidence.$hits, $evidence.$samples, $evidence.$amount, $evidence.$target, $evidence.$suppliers, $evidence.$suitable, $evidence.$relevant, $evidence.$idle, $evidence.$confidence]

set_value.name: $remediation.$diagnosis
set_value.exact: '%1: %2 remained %3 under repeated observation. Verified cause evidence: %4'.[$evidence.$category, $evidence.$subject, $evidence.$state, $evidence.$cause]

set_value.name: $remediation.$shipcapability
set_value.exact: if $role == 'MINING' or $role == 'MINING HUB' then if $windowhits ge 16 then 'Add two Large Miners' else 'Add one Large Miner' else if $windowhits ge 16 then 'Add two Large Traders' else 'Add one Large Trader'

set_value.name: $remediation.$assignment
set_value.exact: if $role == 'MINING' or $role == 'MINING HUB' then 'Mine for Commander' else 'Trade for Commander'

set_value.name: $remediation.$recommendation
set_value.exact: '%1; assign to %2 only after the player verifies the completed ship has the required cargo capability.'.[$remediation.$shipcapability, $remediation.$assignment]

set_value.name: $remediation.$instruction
set_value.exact: 'Build or free the recommended capability using any race, variant and equipment the player chooses. EOC does not require blueprint ownership evidence.'

set_value.name: $remediation.$shipcapability
set_value.exact: if $evidence.$suitable == 0 then if $windowhits ge 16 then 'Add two Large Traders' else 'Add one Large Trader' else 'REASSIGN EXISTING CAPABILITY'

set_value.name: $remediation.$assignment
set_value.exact: 'Trade for Commander'

set_value.name: $remediation.$policy
set_value.exact: 'Create or review the product Sell Order; set a deliberate sell amount, preserve a verified production reserve, and move from Automatic pricing only when evidence supports a controlled price.'

set_value.name: $remediation.$recommendation
set_value.exact: '%1. %2'.[$remediation.$shipcapability, $remediation.$policy]

set_value.name: $remediation.$instruction
set_value.exact: 'Open Station Logical Overview, select the affected product, verify storage allocation, enable a Sell Offer, choose the amount to keep, then set a controlled price only after comparing current demand.'

do_elseif.value: $evidence.$category == 'PRODUCTION SHORTAGE' or $evidence.$category == 'STALLED PRODUCTION' or $evidence.$category == 'WORKFORCE SUPPLY FAILURE' or $evidence.$category == 'WORKFORCE SUPPLY INTELLIGENCE'

set_value.name: $remediation.$policy
set_value.exact: 'Review Automatic trade policy; create or correct the Buy Order for %1, preserve a verified reserve, and use a controlled buy price only when supplier evidence supports it.'.[$evidence.$subject]

set_value.name: $remediation.$shipcapability
set_value.exact: if $evidence.$suitable == 0 and $evidence.$suppliers gt 0 then 'Add one Large Trader' else 'NONE'

set_value.name: $remediation.$assignment
set_value.exact: if $remediation.$shipcapability != 'NONE' then 'Trade for Commander' else 'NONE'

set_value.name: $remediation.$recommendation
set_value.exact: '%1 %2'.[$remediation.$policy, if $remediation.$shipcapability != 'NONE' then $remediation.$shipcapability else 'Use existing logistics first.']

set_value.name: $remediation.$instruction
set_value.exact: 'Open Station Logical Overview, select %1, verify allocated storage and consumption, enable a Buy Offer, set the target amount, review allowed factions, then choose a price supported by observed reachable supply.'.[$evidence.$subject]

set_value.name: $remediation.$policy
set_value.exact: 'Change Automatic trade-rule handling to a deliberate Controlled rule only after confirming which factions must be allowed.'

set_value.name: $remediation.$instruction
set_value.exact: 'Open the station information and Logical Overview, inspect the ware Buy and Sell Offers, review assigned trade rules and blacklists, then select a controlled rule that preserves required supplier and customer access.'

set_value.name: $remediation.$shipcapability
set_value.exact: 'REASSIGN EXISTING SUITABLE TRADER'

set_value.name: $remediation.$assignment
set_value.exact: 'Trade for Commander'

set_value.name: $remediation.$recommendation
set_value.exact: 'Reassign an existing suitable trader before adding new construction.'

set_value.name: $remediation.$instruction
set_value.exact: 'Select a suitable idle player trader, choose Assign to Commander, select this station, and choose Trade for Commander. Request a recheck after assignment.'

set_value.name: $remediation.$instruction
set_value.exact: 'Review the cited evidence and station policy manually. No automated change is authorized or supported for this diagnosis.'

set_value.name: $remediation.$verification
set_value.exact: 'Improvement observed; continue monitoring until six healthy observations and 60 active minutes confirm resolution'

set_value.name: $remediation.$verification
set_value.exact: 'Verified resolved by the bounded SPOS recovery gate'

set_value.name: $remediation.$verification
set_value.exact: 'Remediation did not remain effective; continue diagnosis and apply the next evidence-supported action'

set_value.name: $remediation.$verification
set_value.exact: 'Awaiting remediation; monitoring continues'

set_value.name: $updated
set_value.exact: $updated + 1

set_value.name: $open
set_value.exact: $open + 1

set_value.name: $verifying
set_value.exact: $verifying + 1

set_value.name: $resolved
set_value.exact: $resolved + 1

debug_text.text: '[JKEOC][B70][REMEDIATION_CYCLE] created=%1 updated=%2 open=%3 verifying=%4 resolved=%5 total=%6'.[$created, $updated, $open, $verifying, $resolved, global.$JKEOC_B70Remediations.count]

set_value.name: $capable
set_value.exact: $ship.exists and $ship.owner == faction.player and $ship.isclass.ship and $ship.isoperational and not $ship.isunit and not $ship.isclass.ship_xs and not $ship.assignment? and (($remediation.$assignment == 'Trade for Commander' and $ship.primarypurpose == purpose.trade and $ship.waretransport.indexof.{waretransport.container}) or ($remediation.$assignment == 'Mine for Commander' and $ship.primarypurpose == purpose.mine and $remediation.$subjectkey? and $ship.waretransport.indexof.{$remediation.$subjectkey.waretransport})) and (global.$JKEOC_B76AssignmentMode != 'AUTO-ASSIGN REGISTERED' or global.$JKEOC_B76EligibleShips.indexof.{$ship})

do_if.value: not $matched and $capable and ($remediation.$state == 'OPEN' or $remediation.$state == 'ESCALATED') and $remediation.$shipcapability != 'NONE' and not $remediation.$matchedship.exists

set_value.name: $remediation.$verification
set_value.exact: 'Completed compatible ship recognized; awaiting player authorization for station assignment'

set_value.name: $remediation.$recommendation
set_value.exact: '%1 is compatible. Authorize %2 assignment to %3 from Executive Advisor > Operational Remediation / Trade Control.'.[$life.$shipname, $remediation.$assignment, $remediation.$stationname]

show_notification.text: 'ACTION REQUIRED: EOC recognized %1 for %2. Open Ship Assignment Authorization to approve %3.'.[$life.$shipname, $remediation.$stationname, $remediation.$assignment]

append_to_list.name: global.$JKEOC_B70UnlinkedShips
append_to_list.exact: table[$identity=$life.$identity, $ship=$life.$resultship, $shipname=$life.$shipname, $completed=player.age, $reason='Completion recognized; no independently proven remediation intent link']

debug_text.text: '[JKEOC][B74][SHIP_RECOGNIZED] id=%1 ship=%2 matched=%3 purpose=%4'.[$life.$identity, $life.$shipname, $matched, if $ship.exists then $ship.primarypurpose else 'UNAVAILABLE']

do_if.value: global.$JKEOC_B74PendingRemediation? and global.$JKEOC_B74PendingShip? and global.$JKEOC_B74PendingShip.exists and global.$JKEOC_B74PendingShip.isclass.ship and not global.$JKEOC_B74PendingShip.isunit and not global.$JKEOC_B74PendingShip.isclass.ship_xs and not global.$JKEOC_B74PendingShip.assignment? and global.$JKEOC_B74PendingRemediation.$station.exists

add_player_choice_sub.text: 'INFO: NO COMPLETED RECOMMENDED SHIP IS AWAITING ASSIGNMENT'

set_value.name: $assignment
set_value.exact: if $r.$assignment == 'Mine for Commander' then assignment.mining else assignment.trade

set_value.name: $registeredok
set_value.exact: global.$JKEOC_B76AssignmentMode != 'AUTO-ASSIGN REGISTERED' or global.$JKEOC_B76EligibleShips.indexof.{$ship}

set_value.name: $cargo
set_value.exact: ($r.$assignment == 'Trade for Commander' and $ship.waretransport.indexof.{waretransport.container}) or ($r.$assignment == 'Mine for Commander' and $r.$subjectkey? and $ship.waretransport.indexof.{$r.$subjectkey.waretransport})

do_if.value: $ship.exists and $ship.owner == faction.player and $ship.isclass.ship and $ship.isoperational and not $ship.isunit and not $ship.isclass.ship_xs and not $ship.assignment? and (($r.$assignment == 'Trade for Commander' and $ship.primarypurpose == purpose.trade) or ($r.$assignment == 'Mine for Commander' and $ship.primarypurpose == purpose.mine)) and $registeredok and $cargo and $r.$station.exists and $r.$station.owner == faction.player

set_value.name: $r.$verification
set_value.exact: 'Assignment authorized; verifying commander and role'

debug_text.text: '[JKEOC][B82][ASSIGNMENT_EXECUTED] ship=%1 station=%2 role=%3 mode=%4 registered=%5'.[$ship.name, $r.$stationname, $assignment, global.$JKEOC_B76AssignmentMode, global.$JKEOC_B76EligibleShips.indexof.{$ship}]

show_notification.text: 'WARNING: Assignment target is invalid, incompatible or not registered. No change made.'

debug_text.text: '[JKEOC][B82][ASSIGNMENT_BLOCKED] registered=%1 cargo=%2 purpose=%3 assigned=%4'.[$registeredok, $cargo, if $ship.exists then $ship.primarypurpose else 'UNAVAILABLE', if $ship.exists then $ship.assignment? else false]

set_value.name: $expected
set_value.exact: if $r.$assignment == 'Mine for Commander' then assignment.mining else assignment.trade

set_value.name: $ok
set_value.exact: $ship.exists and $ship.commander == $r.$station and $ship.assignment == $expected

set_value.name: $r.$verification
set_value.exact: 'Assignment verified; monitoring operational recovery'

set_value.name: $life.$terminal
set_value.exact: 'ASSIGNED AND VERIFIED'

show_notification.text: 'ACTION COMPLETE: %1 assigned to %2 as %3. EOC is monitoring recovery.'.[$ship.name, $r.$stationname, $r.$assignment]

set_value.name: $r.$verification
set_value.exact: 'Assignment verification failed; no remediation credit granted'

show_notification.text: 'WARNING: EOC could not verify the ship assignment. Review the ship and station manually.'

set_value.name: $written
set_value.exact: $written + 1

set_value.exact:
